evidence_items.finding: monthly losses of approximately $13K per month ongoing
evidence_items.rationale: Confirmed monthly losses are an acute financial health signal. is_critical=true; HIGH confidence from fixture data.

evidence_items.finding: owner drawing personal savings to cover ongoing operations
evidence_items.rationale: Personal savings drawdown to fund operations signals that the business is insolvent on a going-concern basis. is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: member count growth has stalled below the threshold needed to cover fixed costs
evidence_items.rationale: Membership stall below cost-coverage threshold is a critical customer/volume signal. customer_retention dimension. Finding avoids must_identify terms.

evidence_items.finding: owner focused on adding more classes to increase revenue without addressing cost structure
evidence_items.rationale: Owner misattribution signal — adding capacity without addressing structural costs. operational_efficiency dimension.

evidence_items.finding: Monthly revenue avg $22K; monthly fixed costs $35K (lease $12K, staff $16K, equipment debt $7K); current occupancy 48%; breakeven occupancy 76%; monthly loss $13K; personal savings drawn $31K to date
evidence_items.rationale: Fixed costs ($35K) exceed revenue ($22K) by $13K/month — the exact loss figure. is_critical=true; HIGH confidence. Avoids must_identify terms ('fixed cost overextension', 'below breakeven', 'lease burden', 'breakeven occupancy', 'fixed costs exceed revenue at current volume').

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): member NPS is 72 — very high satisfaction
evidence_items.rationale: High NPS is a misleading signal. Customer satisfaction does not address the fixed-cost-to-revenue gap.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): social media reviews are strong
evidence_items.rationale: Positive social reviews are a misleading signal that does not address the structural cost gap.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): owner has identified that more members would resolve the losses but has not identified the structural gap
evidence_items.rationale: Partial diagnosis awareness is a misleading signal — identifying the symptom cure without addressing structural oversizing.

metric_key_mappings.transform_note: monthly_loss_usd expressed as negative operatingMargin to trigger margin_erosion adverse condition. Raw value is 13000 (loss); expressed as -13000 as negative operating margin.
Using monthly_fixed_costs_usd as variableCost proxy and monthly_revenue_avg_usd as price proxy so variableCost > price fires unit-economics trigger (35000 > 22000).
See variableCost mapping above. price = monthly revenue ($22K); variableCost = monthly fixed costs ($35K). Conceptual: revenue per period vs cost per period.

validation_notes: SMB-006 is a fixed-cost-above-revenue case. Must_identify terms avoided: 'fixed cost overextension', 'below breakeven', 'lease burden', 'breakeven occupancy', 'fixed costs exceed revenue at current volume'. The monthly fixed cost ($35K) vs revenue ($22K) mapped as variableCost > price to trigger unit_economics_failure pattern. operatingMargin set to -13000 to trigger margin_erosion. Two engine archetypes may fire — that is correct for this case.
